quotations.old_english: Swilc forgifnes swilce hit for Gode gebeorhlic sý, and for weorulde áberendlic

source_text: á-berendlic. Add :-- Swilc forgifnes swilce hit for Gode gebeorhlic sý, and for weorulde áberendlic, L. Edg. ii. 1; Th. i. 266, 6. Dóm . . . for worolde áberendlic, L. Eth. vi. 10; Th. i. 318, 7. v. un-áberendlíc, -e.
